items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Well, in fact we all played on the same concert.

ctx.x: Well, now you see, I can tell you what they did. All I know, it went up every Sunday. We used to look at it after it got up in the air. I don't know. I don't know what the idea of setting it up. I don't know. I know positive. I don't think no people went up in it, because it was sent up by gas. And it would stay up for a little time and come down. To my idea, it was more of attraction of the park. You see? Draw people out to the park. That's what I think it was. That's the only thing I could picture it to be. It…

they stayed in there too long. I see. Oh, back to Washington. Eureka was quite a success up there. What about those other bands up there? Did you hear Chris ball about it? Oh, yeah. Chris played on the set.

Well, in fact we all played on the same concert. But they had us on different times and different hours, and then they scheduled some concerts in the day for Chris that we wasn't on, and they scheduled some for Lionel Hamilton that we wasn't on.
